verdicts.evidence: None of the Solo, Team or Business cards has a button; the only action is the blue "Start free" button at the top right of the nav, far from the cards.
The three cards share the same border, white fill and price size ($9, $29, $79), and none has an accent, tint or label setting it apart.

Each card lists three different features (Team: "Up to 10 calendars / Shared availability / Reports"), no card says "Everything in…", and each price reads only "/ month" with no per-user or per-team wording, under the subtitle "Simple plans for teams of every size".
The subtitle reads "Simple plans for teams of every size. Change or cancel whenever you like." and gives no trial length, card requirement or anything specific to Tidewell.
